run_ocr_evaluation: run OCR evaluation on FLORES or UDHR datasets using tesseract or googlevision
run_tesseract_on_flores: run tesseract OCR on FLORES dataset images and compute CER and WER metrics
run_tesseract_on_udhr: run tesseract OCR on UDHR dataset articles and compute average error rates
read_ocr_language_codes: read language codes and tesseract codes from the languages fonts codes CSV file
run_tesseract_on_books: run tesseract OCR on crawled book images and generate 10k 20k and 30k text samples
